core_obligations: (1)=>(2): an open immersion is universally injective and etale (Morphisms/Schemes citations).

(2)=>(3): by the accepted lemma-universally-injective-unramified, a universally injective unramified morphism is a monomorphism locally of finite type; etale = flat + unramified + finite presentation here.

(3)=>(1): a flat monomorphism locally of finite presentation is an open immersion via fppf effectiveness of open morphisms, the induced homeomorphism onto an open, quasi-compactness, and the Descent lemma on descending open immersions.
proof_roadmap: (1)=>(2) citations; (2)=>(3) via the accepted universally-injective-unramified equivalence; (3)=>(1) fppf-open + homeomorphism + quasi-compact + Descent lemma chain.
difficulty_reason: Three-way equivalence; (2)=>(3) and (3)=>(1) chain accepted in-chapter and cross-chapter lemmas; assembly only, each implication is a citation chain.
